title: Names used by batch p1-G03-1 (url_unwrap, urlscan_search, url_domain_blocklists, secret_scanner)

attributes.unwrapped_url: list of destination URLs recovered offline behind link-protection/redirect wrappers (recipient identifiers redacted)
attributes.unwrap_chain: list of unwrapping chains {input, depth, truncated, steps[{wrapper, wrapper_host, wrapped, unwrapped, partial, recipient_kinds, facts, error}], final_url, final_domain_only} (redacted URLs, token kinds only)
attributes.wrapper_hosts: list of link-protection/redirect wrapper hosts seen while unwrapping (noise: never IOCs, never reputation-checked)
attributes.url_decoded_params: Unfurl-style decoded URL values [{where, kind, value?, iso?, redacted?}] (timestamps, snowflake/UUID times, base64 text/URLs); e-mails and tokens appear only as redacted kinds
attributes.recipient_identifiers: kinds of per-recipient identifiers found and redacted in a URL (recipient e-mail, tenant id, tracking token...); values are never kept
attributes.urlscan_scans: dated summaries of public urlscan.io scans [{uuid, label, scanned_at, historical, task_url, page_url, page_domain, page_ip, asn, country, server, title, status, tls_issuer, tags, verdict, screenshot_url, report_url}] (URLs redacted)
attributes.urlscan_totals: urlscan.io search totals per labelled query {label: {total, capped, fetched}} (keyless search covers the last 30 days)
attributes.blocklist_hits: list of local blocklist matches [{list, feed, category, match, key, listed_at, deleted_at, historical, terms, dataset_sha256, fetched_at}]
attributes.blocklists_not_checked: list of {list, reason} for blocklists that could not be checked (missing, stale, licence, key): 'not checked', never 'not listed'
attributes.c2_panel_hints: family hints from the paths of listed C2 panel URLs (e.g. 'bot gate (gate.php)'): hints only, never attribution
attributes.secret_counts: number of distinct secrets per detection rule {rule_id: count} (masked: values are never kept)
attributes.jwt_header: JWT header fields {alg, kid, typ} decoded offline (signature never verified)
attributes.jwt_claims: non-personal JWT claims {iss, aud, exp, iat, nbf} decoded offline plus presence flags of personal claims {has_sub, has_email, has_name} (values never kept)

tags.crypto_scam: listed as a crypto scam / wallet-drainer / fake exchange site
tags.brand_abuse: third-party page reusing the organisation's resources or brand: a brand-abuse candidate to review
tags.phishing_kit_exfil: credential of a phishing-kit exfiltration channel (Telegram bot, Discord webhook, SMTP account)
tags.historical: listing or observation older than 30 days, removed or from a frozen list: not current state
tags.ads_tracking: listed only on ad/tracking blocklists (LOW, tag only, never phishing)
tags.aggregate_list: listed only on an aggregated multi-source blocklist (LOW, tag only, never phishing)

relations.unwraps_to: wrapped URL -> destination URL recovered offline behind a link-protection/redirect wrapper
relations.loaded_by: domain -> domain of a third-party page that loaded its resources (urlscan.io scans)
relations.loads_resource: page/domain -> SHA-256 of a resource it loaded (urlscan.io result)
